sticky-picker-keys.text:
Picker keyboard (Angular Material MatCalendar, built in):
• Enter or Space on the trigger opens it and moves focus to the selected Monday.
• Arrows move one day; Up and Down move one week, so from Monday to Monday.
• Page Up / Page Down go to the previous / next month. Home / End go to the first / last day of the month.
• Enter selects a Monday. Disabled days ignore it (aria-disabled).
• Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
• Selecting closes the popover and writes ?week= to the URL as a new history entry.
